content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element. 2. Validate the five corpus docs (init, appended, undone, undone2, newer) in tests/fixtures/markers/ against schemas/markers.json with python jsonschema; all five validate. 3. Each doc answers to the claim it illustrates — init is the empty/unset/zero state of specs/markers/state.qnt, appended holds the (pre, post) pair that S5-marker-append appends with the position at its post-boundary, undone holds that pair with the undone count at one, the redo bound at one, and the position at its pre-boundary (S5-undo), undone2 holds both pairs with the undone count at two and the redo bound at two, and newer holds a pair bracketed after an undo with the redo bound standing at one and the position at the new pair's post-boundary (S5-marker-append, S5-ordered). Fail on any divergent element — name it.
content.rationale: The corpus is where the schema's admitted shapes, the model's four variables, the appended pair, and the undone pair meet; this check forces every document to answer to all four, so the corpus fixes the file's contents without re-deciding any of them.
